scripts.reset:all: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:reset:erp && npm run db:reset:shop
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate:erp && npm run db:migrate:shop
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:erp && npm run db:seed:shop
scripts.generate: npm run -w packages/store-db generate && npm run -w packages/erp-db generate
